clock_violation_rule.reason: clocks are second-precision strings; the export states uncertainty_seconds per row, so a 1-step negative can be rounding

null_shifts_days.reason: multiples of 7 days keep time-of-day and weekday; brief suggested +-7d; two magnitudes to see sensitivity

n_source_permutations.reason: enough for a stable mean of a permutation null; seed = stats.SEED

burst_gap_s.reason: smallest round gap above 1 s timestamp precision; chosen before looking at any gap distribution

alignment_windows_s.reason: 5 min ~ one agent step, 1 h ~ one task episode; chosen a priori

per_bucket_min_events.reason: below this a per-source rate CI is too wide to read

same_second_rule.value: a report at the same second as the save is in neither the before nor the after window; counted separately

marker_matching.value: case-insensitive substring of catalog markers in body, unquote(body), unquote(unquote(body))
marker_matching.reason: wiki bodies carry proxy URLs with percent-encoded targets

new_mention_rule.value: a (page, source) mention event is a revision whose source set contains the source and the previous held revision of the same page does not
new_mention_rule.reason: bodies accumulate; carry-forward copies are not new evidence

claim_context_chars_before.reason: about five words; enough for 'shared container UTC ' style qualifiers

claim_suffix_chars.reason: catches ' UTC', 'Z', ' GMT' immediately after a time

claim_keywords_real.reason: words that name a wall/server clock in the lens examples ('shared UTC', 'terminal UTC')

claim_keywords_task.reason: words that name the simulated task clock or a future projection in the lens examples

claim_class_rule.value: suffix UTC/GMT/Z -> real; else the keyword closest before the time decides real vs task; none -> unqualified

claims_inside_urls.value: times/ISO stamps inside an http(s) URL token are not claims; epochs inside URLs are kept as a separate class epoch_url
claims_inside_urls.reason: URL parameters can be server-generated (expiry tokens) rather than narrated

epoch_forms.value: 10 digits (optional .fraction), 13, 16 or 19 digits, leading digits 17 or 18 (1.7e9..1.9e9 s)
epoch_forms.reason: python time.time(), JS Date.now(), us and ns stamps

naive_iso_timezone.reason: no offset given; UTC is the server clock's zone

tod_fold.value: time-of-day claims compared modulo 24h, delta folded into [-12h, +12h)
tod_fold.reason: date not stated; assume the claim refers to the instant nearest the save

claim_delta_bins_s.reason: edges at 1 s (server uncertainty), 1 min (HH:MM truncation), 1 h, 1 day

impossible_claim_tolerances_s.reason: claim later than its own save by more than this is counted as physically impossible at that tolerance

save_clock_for_claims.reason: the export's own adjudicated save time

cluster_units.reason: brief: session or page as unit

request_time<=success_time.reason: the request must arrive before the server logs its success

request_time<=write_date.reason: the page-file write cannot precede the request that caused it

request_time<=archived_at.reason: the archive copy cannot precede the request

success_time<=archived_at.reason: the archive copy cannot precede the logged success

write_date<=archived_at.reason: the archive copy cannot precede the write it archives

after_obs.what: report of same source in (t, t+W]

before_shift_null.what: mean over shifts of before-window hit at t+shift

before_perm_null.what: mean over source permutations of before-window hit

before_local_null.what: mean over local shifts of before-window hit
